description: Mentored and trained students in core robotics, embedded systems, and automation concepts. Guided the hands-on development of various hardware and software projects (featured in the Project Vault). Facilitated practical learning in microcontroller programming, sensor integration, and real-world robotics applications.

Implemented robotic systems covering perception fundamentals, IoT communication protocols, and sensor interfacing. Designed and tested an autonomous robotic system with intelligent decision-making using Python and embedded C for real-time control.

Developed responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Engineered a capstone project end-to-end, from requirement analysis and system design to live deployment, gaining practical software development lifecycle experience.
